Messages.Author: Malachy
Messages.Body:
Heys!

Let us assume I have an ally who is Red List. I want to burn him via Set's Curse which burns an ally as a D action. Am I applied to search for a Trophy card?

The main question is can one make a D action against himself? Is it still a D action or it changes like a diablerie action ( D action against others, undirected against self)?

NC of Hungary

///

Messages.Author: jamesatzephyr
Messages.Body:
> Malachy wrote:
> Heys!
>
> Let us assume I have an ally who is Red List. I want to burn him via Set's Curse which burns an ally as a D action. Am I applied to search for a Trophy card?
>
No. Being against yourself, it's not a  action.

> Malachy wrote:
> The main question is can one make a D action against himself? Is it still a D action or it changes like a diablerie action ( D action against others, undirected against self)?
>
Something that affects you - and only you - is an undirected action.

From a  post I wrote some time back :

> I wrote:
> The action is by you against something you control (or pool, hand etc.).
> Therefore, it is an undirected action.
>
> If you take an action that affects someone else (e.g. diablerie, their
> pool, hand etc.), that's a directed action against that Methuselah.
>
> If you take an action that affects someone else (minions, pool, hand
> etc.) and it also affects you, that's a directed action against the
> target. e.g. " Bleed, and untap a minion you control if successful"
> is a directed action against the bleed target - although you get a
> benefit too. It's not directed against you.
>
> If you take an action that affects multiple Methuselahs, all of the
> targets can block and it's a  action against those Methuselahs.
> (Under the old rules, this would be an undirected action.) Example:
> superior Shepherd's Innocence, Border Skirmish.
>
> If it affects multiple Methuselahs _and_ me, it's still a  action
> against those other Methuselahs.
>
> In all circumstances, calling a referendum is an undirected action,
> irrespective of who the referendum will affect (or might affect).
>

Messages.Author: KevinM
Messages.Body:
> Malachy wrote:
> Let us assume I have an ally who is Red List. I want to burn him via Set's Curse which burns an ally as a D action. Am I applied to search for a Trophy card?
>
> The main question is can one make a D action against himself? Is it still a D action or it changes like a diablerie action ( D action against others, undirected against self)?
>
Rulebook, 6.2.2.1: "If the action is not directed at another Methuselah (or at something controlled by another Methuselah), then the action is called undirected..."
